  0.3 * ((session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::bigint) / 10.0 + 
  0.3 * ((session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::bigint) / 20.0 AS tei

  SELECT 
    acct_gate,
    0.4 * (CAST(REPLACE(session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct', '%', '') AS numeric) / 100.0) + 
    0.3 * ((session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::bigint) / 10.0 + 
    0.3 * ((session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::bigint) / 20.0 AS tei
  FROM security_sessions

tei_with_quartile AS (
  SELECT 
    acct_gate,
